description: Private network profile acceptance (13.4, 13.6), stored-profile verification and lockdown, member and host decisions (13.5), and the network fields of the signed bytes (13.2).

accept.name: firstJoinWithConfirmedAdminKey
accept.description: No network yet; the user confirmed the administrator key

accept.name: firstJoinWithoutConfirmation
accept.description: No network yet and no out-of-band confirmation

accept.name: firstJoinNamingAnotherAdministrator
accept.description: The user named a different key than the file is signed by

accept.name: currentAdministratorNewerVersion
accept.description: Same administrator, version above the floor, no confirmation needed

accept.name: olderVersionIsRefused
accept.description: Version 2 after the floor 3: replaying a file from before a revocation

accept.name: sameVersionSameSignatureIsOlder
accept.description: The stored profile imported again is not newer

accept.name: sameVersionDifferentSignatureIsAConflict
accept.description: Same version, other bytes (other members): the administrator must sign a new version

accept.name: versionFloorSurvivesLeavingTheNetwork
accept.description: The client left the network (no current administrator) but keeps the floor 5

accept.name: expiredProfileIsRefused
accept.description: expiresAt one millisecond in the past, no clock-skew allowance

accept.name: expiryExactlyNowIsRefused
accept.description: expiresAt equal to now is not in the future

accept.name: issuedMoreThan24HoursAheadIsRefused
accept.description: issuedAt 24 hours and one millisecond in the future

accept.name: issuedExactly24HoursAheadIsAccepted
accept.description: issuedAt exactly 24 hours in the future

accept.name: changedFieldBreaksTheSignature
accept.description: A member added after signing

accept.name: extendedExpiryBreaksTheSignature
accept.description: expiresAt moved one day later after signing

accept.name: unsignedProfileIsRefused
accept.description: No signature

accept.name: versionZeroIsRefused
accept.description: version must be at least 1

accept.name: validityOverThreeHundredSixtySixDaysIsRefused
accept.description: expiresAt 367 days after issuedAt

accept.name: validityOfThreeHundredSixtySixDaysIsAccepted
accept.description: expiresAt exactly 366 days after issuedAt

accept.name: expiryBeforeIssueIsRefused
accept.description: expiresAt earlier than issuedAt

accept.name: fileAboveOneMebibyteIsRefused
accept.description: A file of 1 MiB + 1 byte

accept.name: fileOfOneMebibyteIsAccepted
accept.description: A file of exactly 1 MiB

accept.name: otherAdministratorWithoutSwitchIsRefused
accept.description: A file from another administrator than the current one

accept.name: otherAdministratorWithExplicitSwitch
accept.description: The user explicitly chose to switch networks and confirmed the key

accept.name: handoverNamesTheNewAdministrator
accept.description: A valid unexpired handover from the current administrator names the signer: no confirmation needed

accept.name: expiredHandoverDoesNotCount
accept.description: The handover has expired

accept.name: handoverToAnotherKeyDoesNotCount
accept.description: The handover names a different new administrator than the signer

accept.name: retiredAdministratorCannotSignAgain
accept.description: The old key was replaced by a handover

accept.name: expiredStoredProfileEndsWithNewerProfileFromTheSameAdministrator
accept.description: The stored profile expired (lockdown); a newer profile from the same administrator ends it without confirmation

accept.name: networkFieldsAreSigned
accept.description: networkId, creator, nonce and creation time are part of the signed bytes

accept.name: networkIdentityReplacedAfterSigningBreaksTheSignature
accept.description: creator, nonce, creation time and the identifier derived from them replaced after signing: consistent, but not what the administrator signed

accept.name: networkIdNotDerivedFromItsFieldsIsRefused
accept.description: networkId replaced after signing by a value that is not the identifier of creator, nonce and creation time

behaviors.name: publicDhtIsRefused
behaviors.requirement: MUST NOT use a public DHT

behaviors.name: publicDhtIsRefusedInLockdown
behaviors.requirement: MUST NOT use a public DHT

behaviors.name: publicBootstrapListIsNotUsed
behaviors.requirement: MUST NOT use a public bootstrap list: the discovery servers are those of the profile and nothing else

behaviors.name: lockdownHasNoDiscoveryServers
behaviors.requirement: Lockdown: no discovery servers, so the client refuses instead of falling back to the public network

behaviors.name: handEditedStoredProfileIsVerifiedAgainWithin60Seconds
behaviors.requirement: A hand-edited stored profile MUST NOT widen access (verified again at least every 60 seconds)
